dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the wide mid-section toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible at this resolution.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with subtle grayscale shading along the lateral flanks due to body curvature.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, thin, intersecting linear marks (rake marks or scratches) on the mid-dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Clearly defined circular blowhole aperture near the anterior; prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge casting a slight shadow along the posterior axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scratches or rake marks distributed across the central dorsal surface.
